Help with Tracksy

Shared expenses, clear balances, straightforward support.

Tracksy helps groups record expenses, calculate each member’s share and keep a history of user-reported settlements. Tracksy does not hold funds or process bank transfers.

Contact support

For sign-in, group access, expense records, privacy requests or a problem with the app, email souravsharma191919@gmail.com. Include your app version and a brief description. Do not send passwords, verification codes, bank credentials or full payment-card details.

Email Tracksy support

Privacy and account requests

Read the privacy policy for information about data handling. To request removal of an account and associated personal data without opening the app, use the account-deletion instructions.

Testing release

The current closed-testing build supports email and Google sign-in, shared groups, expenses and reported settlements. Apple sign-in, store subscriptions, background push delivery and background scheduling are not enabled in this build. Please report issues to support.
